title: The Playlist of Route 9
author: Jude Voss
blurb: Astrid Delacroix, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
